notes.title: New Journey
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]It feels like just yesterday that we first launched Cyberstray 101, and the journey we've shared with you all since then has been nothing short of incredible. Your passion, your feedback, and your stories have been the fuel that powers our small studio. Today, with immense excitement and a healthy dose of nervous energy, we have some big news to share.[/p][p][/p][p]We are thrilled to officially announce that a sequel is in the works! Get ready to dive into Cyberstray 202, a new adventure that will expand upon the world you've come to know.[/p][p][/p][p]We're pouring our hearts and souls into this project, and we're planning to release the first chapter of Cyberstray 202 soon to give you a taste of what's to come.[/p][p][/p][p]The Steam Store page for Cyberstray 202 is currently under construction and will be up for you to wishlist before you know it! We're working hard to make it a perfect introduction to the next chapter of our story.
[/p][p]Creating a game that is several times larger and more ambitious than its predecessor is a massive undertaking for our small team.[/p][p][/p][p]To do this vision justice and maintain our creative independence, we've decided to launch a crowdfunding campaign to help support the development of Cyberstray 202.[/p][p][/p][p]This will allow us to fully realize the scope of the game we dream of making, and we hope you'll consider joining us on this new development journey.[/p][p][/p][p]Your support, whether it's by sharing the news, providing feedback, or simply being part of our community, means the world to us. We genuinely couldn't do this without you.[/p][p][/p][p]Want to get the latest updates, see behind-the-scenes content.[/p][p][/p][p] Join our official Discord server! It's the best place to stay connected and be the first to know about everything related to Cyberstray 202.
[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/BBPSQCrh3R" style="button"]Join Discord[/url]
[/p][p]Thank you for being the best community a developer could ask for. We can't wait to show you what's next.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Stay tuned, and stay awesome.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Warmly,[/p][p]
[/p][p]The N.K Team[/p]

notes.title: Happy New Year & Christmas Special Update 1.03
notes.notes:
Dear 「Players」

As the festive season spreads its joyful cheer, we're thrilled to wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! May this holiday season be filled with moments of love, laughter, and goodwill, and may the year ahead be full of contentment and joy.

We're excited to announce that our game has been updated with the 1.03 Christmas Special Content! Dive into the holiday spirit by accessing the new content directly from the last page in the gallery. This festive addition is our way of saying thank you for your continued support and for being a part of our gaming community.

As we approach the end of 2024, it's hard not to feel a sense of pride and accomplishment. It was around this time last year that the concept of this game was just beginning to take shape in my mind. Fast forward to now, and I'm overjoyed to see how much you've all embraced and enjoyed the game.

In the first installment of the game, I've also discovered areas where I've fallen short. Rest assured, your feedback and criticism are the driving forces behind my commitment to improvement. In the second season, you can expect to see changes that reflect your valuable input.

I'm now fully dedicated to working on the second season of the game. To stay updated with the latest developments, I invite you to join my [url=https://discord.gg/BBPSQCrh3R]Discord[/url] server. Your presence and participation are invaluable as we embark on this new journey together.

Once again, I extend my heartfelt thanks to all our players. Your passion for the game is what makes this all worthwhile. Here's to more exciting adventures in the new year!

Wishing you all a wonderful holiday season, and may the new year bring you joy, success, and all your heart's desires.

notes.title: Cyberstray 101 v1.02 Release
notes.notes:
1. Executive Summary 

We are excited to announce the latest update for our game, which introduces new interactive theater scenes featuring Diana, Belinda, and the protagonist. This update aims to enrich the narrative experience and deepen the connections between characters. We also want to hear from you about any additional character storylines you would like to see in the future.

2. Update Details 

New Interactive Theater Scenes:

Diana and Belinda: We have added a new interactive theater scene between Diana and Belinda, allowing players to witness a unique exchange between these two characters. This scene provides insight into their relationship and adds depth to their individual stories.

Mc and Belinda: A new footjob theater scene between you and Belinda has been introduced.

3. Community Engagement 

We are keen to hear from our players about any additional character storylines they would like to see in the game. Please leave your suggestions and feedback in the comments section below, and we will consider them for future updates.

4. Upcoming Focus 

While our primary focus will be shifting to the script revisions for Season Two, we are committed to ensuring that updates for Episode 101 continue without interruption. We understand the importance of maintaining a steady stream of content for our players and will do our best to balance our development efforts.

5. Acknowledgment 

We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude for the ongoing support from our community. Your enthusiasm and feedback are invaluable to us, and we are dedicated to delivering an engaging and immersive gaming experience.

 Thank you for being a part of our journey. We look forward to bringing you more exciting content and improvements in the coming updates. Stay tuned for more news on Season Two and future interactive scenes.

notes.title: We Are Coming
notes.notes:
Hello fellow gamers and supporters:

I am thrilled to announce that after a year of dedication and hard work, my game has finally been released on Steam! This milestone is not just a testament to the countless hours I've poured into crafting an immersive gaming experience, but also a beacon of hope for independent game developers like myself.

During the development process, I often found myself navigating a sea of solitude. The journey of creating a game is a solitary one, filled with late nights, endless cups of coffee, and a relentless pursuit of perfection. It is in these moments that I realized the importance of community and the invaluable support and feedback that come from it. 

As we stand on the cusp of this new chapter, I want to share with you what's next on the horizon for our game:
[list]

[*]     Bug Fixes: If any gremlins have managed to sneak their way into the game, rest assured that they are my top priority. I am committed to identifying and squashing any bugs that may affect your gameplay experience.

[*]     Translation Optimization: I am dedicated to ensuring that our game resonates with players across the globe. This means refining and optimizing our translations to deliver a seamless experience for all.

[*]     Enhanced Animations: To further immerse you in the game world, I plan to introduce more animated storylines. These will bring our game's narrative to life, adding depth and richness to every scene.

[*] And with the first installment now out in the wild, I am gearing up to pen the script for the sequel. The next chapter in our game's saga is already taking shape in my mind, and I can't wait to share it with you all.

[/list]

Your support on this platform means the world to me. It's not just about funding; it's about building a community of gamers who are as passionate about this game as I am. Your feedback will be the compass that guides our journey, and your encouragement will be the fuel that keeps us moving forward.

Thank you for being a part of this incredible journey. Together, we can take this game to new heights and create a gaming experience that will be remembered for years to come.

Sincerely

Love from NoiseKitty
